# Flooring Hub
> Raleigh / Triangle flooring contractor. Hardwood, LVP, laminate, and carpet installation by Tom Smith. Free in-home estimates.

## Summary & Identity
- Legal / public name: Flooring Hub (also Flooring Hub NC)
- Website: https://www.flooringhubnc.com
- Vertical: Local flooring contractor — not a marketplace, not a materials storefront
- Owner: Tom Smith, Owner & Master Craftsman
- Established: 1999
- Public metrics already used on the site: 25+ years, 500+ homes, 5.0 Google (9 named reviews)
- Pricing: estimates are free and given in person. No published per-square-foot or online calculator prices.

## Services

## Service area
Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Cary, Apex, Garner, Clayton, Fuquay-Varina, Wake Forest, Holly Springs, Pittsboro, Hillsborough, Zebulon.

## How to request an estimate
1. Submit the free estimate form at https://www.flooringhubnc.com/#quote
2. Or call (330) 573-0370
3. Or email tsmith@flooringhubnc.com
Tom reviews requests and usually responds within 24 hours to schedule a free consultation. Do not invent a price.
